name: Newmarket · July Course
_about: Written by tools/course/newmarket/to_race_view.py from courses/newmarket-july-draft.json (Rowley Mile: newmarket); don't edit by hand. World axes as Ascot's: x along the straight (the horses run towards -x), z across (inside rail z 0, the track to z = trackWidth), y up; the winning post on the inside rail is the origin. One path: 'path' and 'heights' for the race engine; pathRail is the inside rail sampled every 'spacing' metres from d0 metres to go (d0 < 0: the run-on past the post).
axes: Origin = winning post on the inside rail; y up. On the straight horses run towards -x, inside rail z = 0 on their right, the track to z = trackWidth on their left. The stands are behind the inside rail (z < 0); the far side (z > trackWidth) faces the Rowley Mile across the Dyke.
direction: clockwise (right-handed: one bend, from the Cesarewitch leg into the July straight)

path.note: For the race engine: each bend as [metres to go where it starts, where it ends, degrees turned]; 'home' = where the home straight starts.

heights.note: The ground's height (m, against the post) every 'spacing' metres to go from 'from', along the inside rail: what the race engine reads (owner, 8 Nov: the dips and the climb count).
